name: devops
description: Azure DevOps for Claude Code: work items, pull requests, sprints, standups and time logging through the pinned @azure-devops/mcp 2.8.0 server and the az CLI, with stock Basic/Agile/Scrum/CMMI process presets and a confirmation gate on every write.

ado_organization.title: Azure DevOps organization
ado_organization.description: Organization name only, e.g. contoso for https://dev.azure.com/contoso. Leave empty to use the ADO_ORGANIZATION environment variable.

ado_token.title: Azure DevOps Personal Access Token
ado_token.description: PAT used by the Azure DevOps MCP server. Stored in the OS credential store. Leave empty to use the ADO_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN environment variable.

ado_project.title: Default project (optional)
ado_project.description: Project the MCP server uses when a tool call names none, so it never stops to ask. Leave empty to use ADO_MCP_PROJECT.

ado_team.title: Default team (optional)
ado_team.description: Team the MCP server uses when a tool call names none. Leave empty to use ADO_MCP_TEAM.

daily_hours_target.title: Daily hours target
daily_hours_target.description: Hours per working day that /workday and /timesheet compare logged time against.

profile_stale_days.title: Profile refresh reminder (days)
profile_stale_days.description: The session-start check suggests /init profile --refresh when the profile is older than this.
